description: Registrar General's Department - Amendment of the Form 'A' of the first sub-section of Births and Deaths Registration Act No. 17 of 1951
categorisation: This gazette contains a rule made by the Minister under the Births and Deaths Registration Act, No. 17 of 1951, specifically amending Form A of the Act. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving the modification of existing legislation, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions the Minister's name and title, it does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the legal/regulatory amendment itself.
